Update: I've already left a review for The Handsome Hound (last year), but I must add to it, thanks to our dog's latest visit. I dropped Maisie off, I collected her, took her for a walk - whilst avoiding mud at all costs - and then I waited for my wife to walk through the door and see her, and her reaction (after lots of "ooh-ing and ahh-ing) was simply, "Andrew just gets it right, doesn't he?"

Yes he does, every time.

After trying many different groomers over the years - some near, some (ridiculously) far away - we were recommended Handsome Hound, et voila, our search was over! The shop is small, it's a one dog out, one dog in system (or two dogs, depending on staff numbers that day), Andrew is friendly and professional, not to mention that Maisie looks absolutely wonderful after her hand-strip and groom.
5 stars without hesitation, wish we'd found THIS Hound sooner!
So pleased to have found Andrew at The Handsome Hound. He always does a beautiful job grooming our bedlington, Lady

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We take all feedback seriously, but we’re unable to find any record of your visit or interaction with our business. If you believe this is a mistake, we’d love the opportunity to learn more and address any concerns you may have. Please feel free to reach out to us directly  and we’ll do our best to assist you.
Highly recommend. I've been with Andrew for 13 years.
Just moved to the area and Bonny had her first groom at The Handsome Hound, super friendly team and a super groom.5*

I recently took my 10 year old westie to the Handsome Hound and I was so impressed. She’s quite nervous of grooming and she normally tries to run out of whatever groomers I take her to but when I picked her up she was so happy and comfortable. They really took time to understand what kind of groom I liked and as a result she looks fantastic. One of my the best grooms she’s ever had! I thoroughly recommend. Thank you for looking after her so well.
Expert grooming. Easy to make/change appointments.
Andrew and his team provide the best cuts, and a very friendly service.
